The '''Council of Moffs''', also known as the '''Moff Council''' or '''Moff Assembly''', was a collective body of ruling [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Council of Moffs could execute large-scale decisions with consensus. Its members were responsible for their own  [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and wielded significant influence.

==Organization==
===In the Imperial Remnant===
{{Quote|The Empire is not run by committee, Princess. If I find that the Moff Council needs to know the substance of your message, then I'll be the one who tells them.|[[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
The Council of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] was, throughout its history, the governing body of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]],<ref name="Specter" /> the [[Fel Empire]],<ref name="Legacy 0" /> and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> Although a strong [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] was the basis of the Imperial Remnant,<ref name="CSWE Pellaeon">{{CSWECite|III|18|Pellaeon, Gilad}}</ref> and was led by the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] as ''de facto'' leader<ref name="NEGTC Pellaeon">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> from its inception in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="Warfare " /> the holder of that position was technically subordinate to the Moffs.<ref name="NEGTC Pellaeon" /> The Council of Moffs had the authority to order the Supreme [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] into military action<ref name="Warfare " /> and to choose the wars in which the Remnant would fight.<ref name="Remnant Part 2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'', part 2</ref><ref name="Revelation Chapter ">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> The Supreme Commander was unable to execute any large-scale decisions without the council's consensus, and in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Pellaeon addressed each Moff as "Your Excellency" while seeking their blessing.<ref name="Specter" />

Nevertheless, Pellaeon was actively withholding information and intelligence from the Moffs by [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], maintaining that the Remnant was not run by a committee.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way" /> Although the Council had kept the Remnant out of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] [[25 ABY/Legends|three years earlier]],<ref name="Remnant Part 2" /> 28 ABY saw Pellaeon tell the Moffs that the Remnant would finally be joining the war effort, their consensus nothing more than a mere formality.<ref name="Remnant Part 4">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'', part 4</ref> Pellaeon's temporary retirement after the war saw the Moff Council lead the Remnant in his absence,<ref name="CSWE Pellaeon" /><ref name="Exile Chapter ">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> as did his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[41 ABY]]. However, the Moffs soon afterward agreed to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] proposal that they install a new [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] as the Remnant's leader&mdash;the alternative was to be brought to justice for several war crimes they had recently committed.<ref name="Invincible" />

Each Moff [[Governor/Legends|governed]] one of the Remnant's [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and was in command of a [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]]. The size of the council was dependent on how much [[Imperial Space|territory]] the Remnant controlled.<ref name="Specter" />

===In the Fel Empire and Darth Krayt's Empire===
[[File:Moff_High_Council_meeting_chambers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Moff Council receives instructions from Darth Maladi.]]
At some point after 44 ABY, Fel became new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], and Imperial space ceased to be known as the "Remnant". The Moff Council remained an important element of the government, not fully controlled by the monarchy, although its organization changed further over time. By the end of the Sith–Imperial War in [[130 ABY]], although the Empire had expanded in size, the Council had contracted, and appears to have numbered just six Moffs. It was now led by a [[High Moff]], and known as the "Moff High Council."

These Moffs still controlled one sector each, but all of them were now also in charge of elements of the federal Imperial apparatus. The High Moff was [[Morlish Veed]], who also served as the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] in charge of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], suggesting that the ''ex officio'' connection between the role of Supreme Commander and the leadership of the Council had been restored. The other positions on the council were the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] (a role taken by the female Moff [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] in 130-[[137 ABY]]), the head of the [[Imperial Mission]] ([[Konrad Rus]]), the commanders of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] ([[Rulf Yage]]), and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] ([[Geist (Moff)|Geist]]), and the leader of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]] (a position held at this time by [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro|Fehlauur]], the only alien on the Council, a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who was also responsible for relations with [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|his people's government]]). The Council of Moffs answered to [[Darth Krayt]], who usually did not bother himself with bureaucratic matters of the state, leaving them to the Council.

Some Moffs still retained the old prejudices, and many of them were opposed to letting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] become Empress simply because of her sex, but others were more open-minded and liberal, and as well as women, at least one [[near-Human]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] had become a Moff by this date.
By [[130 ABY]], the Moffs held considerably more power, and were true partners to the Emperor. They, and not the Emperor, also controlled the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Service]] and [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]; the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] and the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] were on the Council. It was the Council who invoked the [[Treaty of Anaxes]] to launch the Sith–Imperial War.

At the end of the war, they pledged allegiance to [[Darth Krayt]], although some of them still harbored sympathy to the then fugitive [[Roan Fel]]. With Coruscant under the grip of the Empire, the Council held its meetings inside a [[Moff High Council meeting chambers|conference chamber]] within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|New Imperial Palace]]. While some Moffs considered the war and the coup as a way to reassert their dominance, in the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new order]] established by Darth Krayt, the Council now answered to Krayt's [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], particularly [[Darth Maladi]] and [[Darth Wyyrlok]].

==History==
The Council of Moffs was in existence as early as [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] was born. By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] they were based in [[Disra's palace]] on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[41 ABY]], the Council supported an alliance with [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] in order to reclaim [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] and [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]; when [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was murdered at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], they took over the Remnant and directed it to continue working with Darth Caedus.

[[File:LegacyImps.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Moff Council in 130 ABY]]
When the Imperial Remnant reasserted itself as a Galactic power, the Moff Council continued to exist under the rule of the [[Fel dynasty]]. Seeking to reassert Imperial domination over the Galaxy and tired of how Emperor Roan Fel constantly played them off against one another, they overruled his objections and declared war on the Galactic Alliance with the help of the [[One Sith]]. By the later stages of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the Moffs on the council were known by the title of [[High Moff]]. With the defeat of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in [[130 ABY]], they relocated to Coruscant, and by [[137 ABY]] if not earlier, the body was styled the "Moff High Council."

They soon came to regret their decision however, as once the war ended, the new Sith leader, Darth Krayt, promptly deposed Roan Fel, and installed himself as the new Emperor, forcing Fel into exile. The council immediately realized that they'd helped replace a relatively benevolent ruler for a dictatorial one. Krayt forced them into swearing allegiance to him, though some soon started plotting against him and the rest of the Sith.
